question: According to the Sustainable Development Report 2025, what percentage of the rural population in India has access to all-weather roads?
solution:
The correct answer is __**99.0%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the **Sustainable Development Report 2025**, India has made significant strides in rural connectivity, with **99.0%** of the **rural population** having access to **all-season roads**.
 
• This indicator is vital for measuring progress under **Sustainable Development Goal 9 (SDG 9)**, which focuses on building resilient infrastructure, promoting inclusive and sustainable industrialization, and fostering innovation.
 
• The high percentage of connectivity reflects the successful implementation of large-scale infrastructure projects aimed at bridging the **urban-rural divide** and ensuring that remote habitations are not isolated during monsoons or extreme weather.
 
• Access to **all-weather roads** is a critical driver for **socio-economic development**, as it facilitates the movement of goods, provides easier access to **healthcare facilities**, and increases **school enrollment** rates in rural areas.
